The presence of a causal relationship from Duloxetine to Npy1r implies that Venlafaxine may influence Npy1r through its interaction with Duloxetine, potentially modulating NPY signaling pathways. The integration of these pathways highlights a possible role in regulating blood pressure, though the direct effect of Venlafaxine on Npy1r remains unclear.
